Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the group number of Selenium in the periodic table. Selenium (Se) is in Group 16 (also known as Group VI A), which means it has 6 valence electrons. The Planner mistakenly associated Selenium with Group 15 (which has 5 valence electrons), leading to the wrong conclusion that the answer is B) 5 instead of the correct answer C) 6. This is a fundamental error in recalling or applying periodic table trends regarding valence electrons.
